objectives: Describe how Abraham's inheritance went to Isaac.
Explain the prophecy of two nations in Rebekah's womb.
Explain how Esau despised his birthright.
takeaways: Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac, and sent the sons of the concubines away eastward.
Ishmael's twelve princes fulfilled the promise of Genesis 17:20.
Two nations were in Rebekah's womb, and the elder shall serve the younger; good is set against evil (Ecclesiasticus 33:14-15).
Jacob's hand on Esau's heel is prophecy: Esau is the end of the world, Jacob the beginning that followeth (2 Esdras 6:7-9).
Esau sold his birthright for red pottage; thus Esau despised his birthright.
